clauses.title: Context of the organization
clauses.text: The organization shall determine internal and external issues, interested parties and requirements relevant to the AI management system.

clauses.title: Leadership and commitment
clauses.text: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment to the AI management system, ensuring policy and objectives are established and compatible with strategic direction.

clauses.title: AI risk assessment
clauses.text: The organization shall define and apply an AI risk assessment process that identifies, analyses and evaluates AI risks.

clauses.title: Operational planning and control
clauses.text: The organization shall plan, implement and control the processes needed to meet AI management system requirements and to address AI risks and impacts.

clauses.title: Performance evaluation
clauses.text: The organization shall determine what needs to be monitored and measured, the methods used, and when results shall be analysed and evaluated.

clauses.title: Responsible AI control objectives (Annex A)
clauses.text: Organizations shall implement controls covering fairness, security, transparency, accountability, human oversight and impact assessment of AI systems.
